arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Mancino argued the side that brought the case followed the district court's specific order.
Mr. Stewart argued the deadline is jurisdictional and cannot be waived.
Justice Kennedy noted the rule includes equitable conditions and time limits.
Chief Justice Roberts emphasized the drafters wanted a safety valve with limits.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines whether judges can extend strict appeal deadlines. It affects every person who appeals a civil judgment. It determines if a missed deadline ends a case immediately. It shapes how courts manage their own schedules. It impacts the finality of lower court decisions.
